description: This Java class defines a response object for the DeleteAclEntry command within the Eclipse Ditto platform. It encapsulates details about the deleted ACL entry, including the associated Thing ID and Authorization Subject, and provides methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON representations, as well as methods for serialization and comparison.

classes.name: DeleteAclEntryResponse
classes.description: Represents the response received after deleting an ACL entry, containing the Thing ID and Authorization Subject associated with the deletion.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create an instance of DeleteAclEntryResponse from parameters, either using String or ThingId for the Thing ID, along with AuthorizationSubject and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of DeleteAclEntryResponse from a JSON string or JsonObject, parsing the needed fields and headers.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the related Thing entity.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Returns the AuthorizationSubject associated with the deleted ACL entry.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON pointer path to the resource, specifically the ACL associated with the AuthorizationSubject.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the response into a JSON object, including the Thing ID and Authorization Subject, respecting schema versions.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders added.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns an array indicating the schema versions supported by this response type, in this case only V_1.
